output_list.criticism: The function distr() has an integer overflow vulnerability. The totalDistributed variable is increased by the _value parameter, which can be a large number. If the totalSupply is not checked, the totalDistributed variable can become larger than the totalSupply, leading to an integer overflow.

The function getTokens() has a wrong logic vulnerability. The function first checks if the value is greater than the totalRemaining variable. If it is, it sets the value to the totalRemaining variable. Then, it checks if the value is less than or equal to the totalRemaining variable. If it is, it distributes the tokens. If the totalDistributed is greater than or equal to the totalSupply, it sets the distributionFinished variable to true. The function also sets the value to a value that is a fraction of the totalRemaining variable. This can lead to an incorrect distribution of tokens.

The function distr() has an integer overflow vulnerability. The totalDistributed variable is increased by the _amount parameter, which can be a large number. If the totalSupply is not checked, the totalDistributed variable can become larger than the totalSupply, leading to an integer overflow.
